sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:54546-Db
Court No. - 3
Case :- Writ - C No. - 6749 of 2024

Petitioner :- Soni
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru.
The Prin. Secy. Revenue Civil Secrt. Lko.
And Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Dhruvendra Kumar Singh
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Sarvesh Kumar Dubey
Hon'ble Mrs. Sangeeta Chandra,J.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State Respondents and Ms. Samidha, Advocate, who has filed his memo of appearance on behalf of the opposite parties no.
2 & 3.
2.

This writ petition has been filed with the following main prayers:-
"i. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opp.

Parties concerned to take the necessary action regarding the grievance of the petitioner raised in their application dated 02.07.2024 contained in Annexure no. 1 Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin. Secy. ... on 8 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72936329/
1 to this writ petition and also provide the fair and proper compensation of plot of petitioner which is part of gata no. 183 area 60.70 sq. mts.

entities.text: Annexure no. 1 Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. The Prin. Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Situated in village Fatehpur Pargana Hadaha Tehsil and District Unnao of Rs. 5,85,480/- in the interest of justice.

ii. Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opp.
Parties concerned to consider and decide the application of the petitioner as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this writ petition expeditiously within the stipulated time as provided by this Hon'ble court in interest of justice."
3.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the NHAI has pointed out that the petitioner is aggrieved by the determination of compensation which has been awarded by the Competent Authority Land Acquisition.
Against such order the petitioner has remedy under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition stands disposed of with a direction to the petitioner to approach the Competent Authority under the National Highways Act, 1956 under Section 3G(5).
Order Date :- 8.8.2024 Darpan Sharma  Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru.
